sample_unit: Nigerian pediatric chest radiographs (external test set)
models_evaluated: CNN pneumonia classifier trained on open-source USA paediatric CXR dataset

links.outcome: AI performance on local prospective data versus internal test data
links.effect: Internal test: 86% accuracy, 0.93 AUC; external Nigerian test: 58% accuracy, 0.48 recall, 0.65 AUC.
links.quote: The model achieved 86% accuracy, 0.83 precision, 0.98 recall, 0.79 F1-score, and 0.93 AUC on the internal test, and 58% accuracy, 0.62 precision, 0.48 recall, 0.68 F1-score, and 0.65 AUC on the external test.

links.outcome: Performance gap between development population/setting and local deployment setting
links.effect: Large drop from internal to external test attributed to differences in imaging protocols and equipment between LMIC and high-income settings.
links.quote: This performance gap likely stems from differences in imaging protocols/equipment between LMICs and high-income settings.

unlisted_practices: Developing locally relevant African paediatric CXR datasets for AI development

screen.reason: Evaluates external validation/generalizability of a CXR AI model trained on US data when applied to prospective pediatric CXR data from a low-resource setting in Nigeria, showing significant performance drop.
